issue.title: Catch exception on tf_session.TF_NewStatus()

repository.name: tensorflow
repository.description: An Open Source Machine Learning Framework for Everyone

issue.body: "try" and "finally" without "except" is not sufficient to catch the exception.  If the exception gets thrown, it can stop output from other threads from being printed, and the exception makes TF appear to be broken.  Fixes #8652

body:

Getting similar error. Has only happened in last 24-36 hours or so:

**AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'update'**

I had the same problem and checking the code in the file /lib/python3.5/site-packages/tensorflow/python/client/session.py shows this:
```
try:
        status = tf_session.TF_NewStatus()
        tf_session.TF_DeleteDeprecatedSession(self._session, status)
```

the error could be avoided with something like this:
```
try:
        if tf_session is not None:
            status = tf_session.TF_NewStatus()
            tf_session.TF_DeleteDeprecatedSession(self._session, status)
```
